one_line: This ad demonstrates the Refina AI app, showing how users can preview cosmetic procedures on their own faces to make informed decisions at home.

hook.what_happens: A woman performs the 'mirror test' by pulling her facial skin back.
hook.why_it_works: It targets a highly relatable, universal behavior for anyone considering cosmetic procedures.

shots.description: A woman demonstrates the manual 'mirror test' in her bathroom.
An AI face mesh overlay appears on her face with option chips.
A mobile app mockup shows photo upload and procedure selection.
A side-by-side comparison of the original and rendered face with a slider.
Cards representing different procedures are swiped and ruled out.
Multiple user portraits are shown to emphasize private, at-home decision making.
Final comparison with a disclaimer and a call to action to download the app.

onscreen_text.text: Pulled the skin back at your temples.
Lifted your cheek with two fingers.
A guess you make with your hands
And see it rendered on your own face.
Not a diagram. Not a gallery. Your face.
Three things change once you can see it.
The picture in your head was never accurate.
It was hope on a good day
and dread on a bad one.
Now it is just a photograph.
Second, you find out what you don't want.
Ruling a procedure out is an answer too,
And third, you decide before anyone is selling to you.
At home. On your own time.
Not across a desk from someone
with a price list and a waiting room.
What it is, and what it isn't
Refina is a preview, not a promise.
But you should get to see it
before you spend another year imagining it.
Search Refina AI on the App Store.

transcript.text: You've done it in the mirror. Pulled the skin back at your temples. Lifted your cheek with two fingers. Held it there. Let go. A guess you make with your hands and finish in your head.
So we built Refina. Upload one photo. Choose the procedure you're considering. And see it rendered on your own face.
Three things change once you can see it. First, you stop guessing.
Second, you find out what you don't want. Ruling a procedure out is an answer too, and it costs you nothing.
And third, you decide before anyone is selling to you. At home. On your own time. Not across a desk from someone with a price list and a waiting room.
Refina is a preview, not a promise. Your surgeon determines your result. But you should get to see it before you spend another year imagining it.

narrative_arc: Identify the relatable habit of manually pulling back skin to imagine cosmetic results.
Introduce Refina AI as the solution to visualize these changes accurately.
Explain the benefits: eliminating guesswork, ruling out unwanted procedures risk-free, and making pressure-free decisions at home.
Provide a realistic disclaimer while encouraging the user to take action and download the app.

cta.what: Search Refina AI on the App Store.

subjects.name: Unnamed Woman
subjects.role: User demonstrating the mirror test and showing the AI transformation results.

what_makes_it_work: Highly relatable opening hook that captures immediate attention.
Clear, step-by-step app demonstration showing realistic results.
Strong emotional framing contrasting 'dread' and 'hope' with objective visualization.
Empowers the user by emphasizing control, privacy, and cost-free decision making.

animations.name: Drawn Callouts
animations.what_moves: Labels and leader lines pointing to the temple and cheek
animations.purpose: Highlights specific facial areas being manipulated in the mirror test.
animations.reusable_as: Labeling key features on any product or anatomical diagram.

animations.name: Grid Overlay Reveal
animations.what_moves: A geometric mesh grid over the face
animations.purpose: Simulates AI facial analysis and scanning technology.
animations.reusable_as: Showing technical analysis or scanning of any object.

animations.name: Tag Stack Pop
animations.what_moves: Multiple choice option chips at the bottom
animations.purpose: Presents user options in a playful, interactive format.
animations.reusable_as: Displaying tags, categories, or multiple-choice answers.

animations.name: App Screen Transition
animations.what_moves: Mobile app screens and selection menus
animations.purpose: Demonstrates the user flow within the mobile application.
animations.reusable_as: Showing UI navigation in any app demo.

animations.name: Before/After Slider Sweep
animations.what_moves: A vertical divider line sweeping across the face
animations.purpose: Compares the original face with the simulated treatment result.

animations.name: Horizontal Card Carousel
animations.what_moves: A row of procedure cards sliding horizontally
animations.reusable_as: Browsing a gallery of products or features.

animations.name: Scattered Card Pile
animations.what_moves: Multiple portrait photos dropping and stacking
animations.purpose: Visualizes a collection of different user profiles or results.
animations.reusable_as: Displaying a stack of user testimonials or photos.
animations.would_need_building: A physics-based or staggered card stacking component with slight rotations.

animations.name: Timeline Slider Progress
animations.what_moves: A slider handle moving along a timeline track
animations.purpose: Represents the passage of time spent imagining results.
animations.reusable_as: Showing progress, adjustment, or timeline navigation.
animations.would_need_building: An animated slider component with a moving thumb and active track fill.

signature_moves: Interactive slider sweeps for before/after comparisons
Staggered tag pops for user choices
Drawn callouts for precise anatomical labeling
animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Elements scale up with a springy bounce or slide in from the bottom.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Elements fade out or slide down out of frame.
animation_language_summary.how_scenes_change: Hard cuts combined with sliding UI panels.
animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The central portrait of the woman remains the focal point.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Bursty, with moments of static demonstration followed by rapid UI interactions.

what_we_should_steal: The interactive before/after slider sweep for instant visual comparison.
Staggered card pile animation to show a variety of user examples dynamically.
Drawn callouts to highlight specific product details or features.
